A shoemaker from Dorking, Surrey. Signed the Mayflower Compact and died at Plymouth on 21 February 1621,
in the first winter. Alice, wife of William Mullins of Dorking, Surrey.
She sailed with him on the Mayflower in 1620 with their daughter Priscilla and son Joseph.
Alice, William and Joseph all died at Plymouth that first winter; Priscilla survived and married John Alden.
